source: Public hero/ability PNG mirrors and decoded pinned Valve static HUD resources; no game captures
limitations: CDN URLs are not client-versioned; content hashes pin the retrieved template bytes, not independent Valve build authentication.
HUD glyphs are bound to cached static client resources by CRC32/SHA256 and decoder provenance; valve-resource URLs are metadata, never runtime download targets.
Full templates do not prove HUD crop, state, identity, inventory ownership, unlocked state, or ability rank.
